title: The anatomy of a one-take video: Everything you need, right in your browser
summary: Record polished videos right from your browser or LMS with Kaltura Express Capture 2.0. No downloads, just built-in tools for easier, confident recording.
body_markdown:
### **Meet Kaltura Express Capture 2.0, your browser-based recording studio for creating better videos, faster and with less effort.**


It was supposed to be a quick video. Two minutes to update your team, introduce next week’s lesson, walk a customer through a new feature, or submit a video assignment for class. Nothing complicated.


But first, you need to open your recording software. If it’s not installed, that’s another hurdle. Then there’s the microphone setup, the camera adjustments, and figuring out where the finished recording needs to go.


Forty minutes and six takes later, you’ve forgotten your opening line, your microphone sounds like you’re recording from your closet, and you’ve become painfully aware of the box of tissues on the shelf behind you that looks like it’s coming out of your head.


The funny thing is, none of this has anything to do with what you actually wanted to say.


Video has become a natural part of how we work, teach, and communicate. Yet many recording workflows still feel unnecessarily complicated, especially when all you want to do is capture a quick explanation and share it.


**Kaltura Express Capture 2.0** takes a simpler approach. It brings recording directly into your browser, embedded in the Kaltura platforms and learning management systems you already use. No separate application to install, no complicated setup, and no need to juggle different tools just to get a video from your camera to your audience.


And with a few helpful features built in, getting a good recording is easier too.


Here’s how to make the most of it.


## Before the recording: Get the little things right


There’s nothing quite like finishing what you thought was a great explanation, watching it back, and realizing you’ve spent the whole time sitting awkwardly off-center.


Most recording problems are easier to prevent than fix. That’s why Express Capture gives you feedback before you press Record.


**Framing assistance** helps you position yourself naturally in the shot, while


**lighting alerts** flag when your surroundings are too dark, too bright or uneven. An


**audio-level indicator** lets you see whether your microphone is picking you up properly, and built-in noise suppression, echo cancellation, and automatic gain control help keep your voice clear.


These might sound like small details, but together they remove much of the guesswork.


## Behind the scenes: Nobody needs to see your laundry


Not everyone has a beautifully organized home office. Some of us are recording in spare bedrooms, shared workspaces, dorm rooms, or whatever quiet corner we can find.


And that’s perfectly fine. Your surroundings don’t need to become part of your message. Express Capture lets you blur your background or replace it altogether.


And if there’s a pile of laundry just outside the frame? That’s between you and the laundry.


## During the recording: Know what you’re going to say


For many people, the hardest part of recording isn’t the technology. It’s talking to a camera.


You know your subject inside out. You know what you want to communicate. You’ve even thought of clever asides to keep things breezy. But somehow, the moment the little red light comes on, your carefully organized thoughts decide to take a break.


Enter the


**built-in teleprompter** .


Paste in a script or a few talking points, position the prompter near your webcam, and let the text scroll while you speak. You can adjust the font size, contrast, and scrolling speed to suit your delivery. Y


our audience never sees it.


The teleprompter helps you stay on track and focus on what you’re saying rather than remembering every word. Just remember, there’s a difference between using a teleprompter and sounding like you’re reading a legal disclaimer.


A conversational script, a comfortable pace, and the occasional pause still make all the difference.


## Beyond the talking head: Show what you mean


Sometimes a face-to-camera message is exactly what you need. Other times, showing something is better than describing it.


Express Capture lets you record your camera, your screen, or both together.


When you capture your screen and camera simultaneously, they’re saved as separate, synchronized video streams. In the Kaltura Player, viewers can choose how they want to watch: focusing on the presentation, seeing the speaker, or viewing both side by side.


That flexibility opens up plenty of possibilities. A trainer can demonstrate a business application, an instructor can walk through a complicated chart, and a student can explain a project on screen while remaining visible to the person assessing their work.


## From recording to sharing


With traditional recording tools, finishing your video is sometimes just the beginning. You still need to find the file, upload it to the right platform, and make sure it reaches the people who need it.


Express Capture removes much of that back-and-forth.


It’s available directly within


**Kaltura Content Hubs, LMS integrations, and Rich Media CMS** , so you can start recording from the environment where your content already lives.


For educators and students, that means recording lessons, presentations, or video assignments without leaving their familiar learning environment. For teams using Kaltura to share knowledge and communicate, it means fewer tools and a more straightforward path from idea to video.


Once you’ve finished recording, you can review your video, download a copy, or record again if something needs fixing. When you’re happy with it, just click


**Use this** and it automatically goes where it needs to


There’s also a reassuring privacy detail: recording assistance, background effects, and teleprompter processing happen locally in your browser. Your recording isn’t uploaded to Kaltura until you choose to use it.


With Kaltura Express Capture 2.0, you don’t need to set aside time to learn another recording tool or navigate a complicated production process. You can open your browser, get yourself ready, and focus on what you actually want to say.


Give it a try. You might even get it right on the first take.


## FAQs


**Do I or my viewers need to install any software or browser extensions?**


No. Express Capture 2.0 runs 100% natively inside standard desktop browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple Safari). There are no desktop apps to download, no plugins to install, and no IT administrative permissions required.


**Can viewers see my teleprompter script in the final video?**


No. The teleprompter overlay, framing guides, and lighting alerts run strictly on your local screen and are visible only to you. The final video uploaded to Kaltura captures only your camera and/or screen, with crisp delivery and direct eye contact.


**Is my recording private while I’m setting up or testing?**


Yes. Express Capture 2.0 is built with client-side privacy by design. Video assistance, lighting checks, background segmentation, and teleprompter scrolling are processed locally within your browser engine. Nothing is transmitted or uploaded to Kaltura until you review your take and click


**“Use this.”** If you don’t like a take, you can discard it locally with zero footprint in your media library.


**Can I record on mobile devices or tablets?**


Express Capture 2.0 is currently designed for desktop browsers (laptops and desktop computers). However, you can easily create mobile-ready content using the


**9:16 Portrait** mode directly from your laptop webcam, making it simple to produce vertical videos for mobile learners and social feeds.


**How does dual-stream screen and camera recording work for viewers?**


When you choose to record both your screen and camera, Express Capture captures them as two separate, synchronized video streams rather than baking your webcam permanently into the corner of your slides. When played back in the Kaltura Player, viewers can customize their own viewing experience, toggling between picture-in-picture, side-by-side, or full-screen slides as they learn.


**Can I download a local backup of my recording?**


Yes. On the post-recording review screen, you have options to preview your clip, record again, select


**Use this** to upload directly to your Kaltura account, or download a local copy (WebM/MP4) directly to your computer.


**How do administrators enable Express Capture 2.0, and does it cost extra?**


Express Capture 2.0 is included at no additional cost. To enable it across your Kaltura Content Hubs (MediaSpace) or LMS integrations (Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle), an administrator simply needs to navigate to the


**Recorder** module in the Configuration Management admin console and set Recorder Version to


**Version 2.0** . All existing permissions, recording time limits, and conversion profiles carry over automatically.
